proposed_widenings.name: PassiveMechanics.lineage_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait requires a build-time choice among mutually exclusive passive bundles, and each bundle carries different grants.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage."

proposed_widenings.name: character_level_gated_passive_grant
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait grants additional benefits only when the character later reaches levels 3 and 5; current passive grants apply immediately and have no character-level unlock schedule.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table."

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spellcasting_ability_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: The granted lineage spells use a trait-scoped chosen ability (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma), which the current spell-access grant shape cannot express.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage)."

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.rest_reselect_cantrip_from_list
proposed_widenings.justification: High Elf grants a cantrip that can be replaced after each Long Rest from a constrained spell list; current spell-access modes grant fixed named spells only.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list."

notes: Did not author content/species_elf_elven_lineage.dhall. Existing atoms cover the branch payloads themselves (for example darkvision increase, speed increase, spell access), but the passive surface cannot represent lineage selection plus later character-level unlocks without mis-stating when grants apply.
